source.title: State of Marketing 2026 Report — AI, Brand POV & Human-Led Growth
source.extraction_method: Press coverage aggregation (Replit app is JS-rendered; PDFs collected by owner were screenshot-only with sparse text). All numbers cross-referenced from HubSpot's own blog + secondary press summaries.
source.license_note: Free annual report by HubSpot; cite when used.

ai_disruption.note: The competitive edge in 2026 is no longer 'who uses AI' — it's HOW well, with a defensible brand POV. AI-generated bland content is the new noise; distinctive humanity is the differentiator.

short_form_video.note: Short-form video named most-valuable channel by 104% more marketers vs 2024.

social_media.note: Brand awareness is now the #1 priority for ~60% of social media marketers — more than doubled vs prior year.

ai_aversion_data_points.ai_content_repulsion_summary: Audiences aren't rejecting AI tools — they're rejecting AI SLOP (low-quality, repetitive, uncurated). 30% of consumers (Hootsuite 2026) say they're less likely to choose a brand if they know the ads are AI-generated. HubSpot data confirms 65% of marketers say consumers can now identify AI content. Implication for AdProof: flag obviously-AI creatives, prioritise human-feeling craft signals.
